standard.note: Public Act 19-4 indexed Connecticut to the federal Employment Cost Index from 2024; $16.35 in 2025, $16.94 in 2026. 2027: $17.48 (see provisional.updatedFor2027).

tipped.note: Connecticut runs TWO tipped rates, split by occupation rather than by employer: hotel and restaurant staff at a $6.38 cash wage, bartenders at $8.71. Both are frozen dollar figures, so every ECI increase lands entirely on the tip credit.

variants.label: Bartender cash wage
variants.test: An employee who customarily and regularly receives tips while working as a bartender.
variants.note: Conn. Gen. Stat. 31-60(b) sets a separate, smaller tip credit for bartenders.

sources.title: Governor Lamont announces Connecticut's minimum wage will increase to $17.48 on January 1, 2027
sources.verifiedBy: Read directly 2026-10-25: 'Connecticut's minimum wage will adjust to $17.48 per hour beginning January 1, 2027'. The tipped cash wages ($6.38 / $8.71) are frozen dollar amounts in this file, so only the tip credit grows.
